headline: Bowers fall to 1-8 despite a big Deebo Samuel Sr. game
dek: ATX Bowers scored 100.22 and lost by 50.8 to I Love it Ra, with 13.7 points left on the bench.

sections.title: Your week
sections.md:
ATX Bowers lost 151.02 to 100.22 against I Love it Ra and sit at **1-8**. Even the perfect lineup (**113.92**) wouldn't have won, so this one wasn't a lineup problem. The team was outscored, and **88%** efficiency is fine.

**What worked**
- Deebo Samuel Sr. was the MVP with **25.9**. Our projection had him at 10.99.
- Tony Pollard added **23.9** and Rashee Rice **13.2**.

**What didn't**
- Denzel Boston was the dud at **2.6**, against a projection of 10.84.
- Drake Maye scored **3.02** against a projection of 17.93. The Goff news item says Maye left the game early with an ankle injury, so that line is mostly about the injury.
- BAL D/ST scored 4.0 against a projection of 9.91.
- Tank Dell scored 5.1.

**The bench cost 13.7 points**
- Aaron Jones scored **12.5** on the bench while Boston put up 2.6. That swap was worth 9.9 points.
- Brenton Strange scored **8.9** on the bench while Dell scored 5.1. That swap was worth 3.8 points.

The trade deadline is Week 11. With one win, that is the next decision point.

sections.title: Could you have known?
sections.md:
**Aaron Jones over Denzel Boston: variance.** Every pre-game signal favored the player you started.
- Our projection had Boston at **10.84** and Jones at 9.42.
- Boston played **88%** of snaps over the last three games, with a **25%** target share and **14.7** xFP.
- Jones's snaps fell from 58% on the season to **33%** over the last three. His last-three average was 4.2, with **4.9** xFP.
- Jones's team implied total was 20.0, and Boston's was 18.0.

Nothing pointed to Jones. He scored 12.5 and Boston scored 2.6.

**Brenton Strange over Tank Dell: too close to call.** Our projection had Strange at 9.49 and Dell at 9.28.
- Dell had only two games of data and played 35% of snaps.
- Strange's team implied total was **28.0**, against 22.5 for Dell's.
- That is a slight lean to Strange, but not enough to call it a clear miss.

sections.title: Top performers
sections.md:
**Biggest scores**
- **Christian McCaffrey** (Game of Throws) scored **46.3** on 16.3 xFP.
- **Jahmyr Gibbs** (Justiniscleann) scored **44.2**.
- **George Pickens** (Lover Boys) scored **43.5**, with Ja'Marr Chase adding 34.1 for the same team.
- **Patrick Mahomes** scored **35.4**, but Lover Boys had him on the bench.
- **Dak Prescott** scored 34.4 for The Dakstreet Boys, the week's high-scoring team.

**Position leaders**
- **TE:** Isaiah Likely led with 27.7 for I Love it Ra.
- **K:** Cam Little scored 19.0.
- **DEF:** MIN D/ST scored 22.0 for Just Win Baby.

**Beat expectations (PPR vs xFP)**
- McCaffrey scored 46.3 on 16.3 xFP.
- Deebo Samuel Sr. scored **25.9** on 6.8 xFP, which is a big overperformance. That is a reason to treat his week as partly luck.
- Brock Purdy scored 31.7 on 13.7 xFP.
- Amon-Ra St. Brown scored 25.8 on 8.0 xFP.

**Usage without the points**
- Jalen Coker had **12.7** xFP and scored 0.3.
- Bryce Young had 19.6 xFP and scored 8.1.
- Justin Jefferson had 25.3 xFP and scored 16.4.
- Garrett Wilson had 24.0 xFP and scored 15.6.

sections.title: Injuries on the field
sections.md:
**Hurt this week**
- **Drake Maye** (NE, ours): he left early against Detroit with an ankle injury. The news facts give no word on his status. Watch the practice reports.
- **A.J. Brown** (NE, Game of Throws): he left in the second half with a hamstring injury and was ruled out. He had returned this week after a two-game absence and had 27 yards on two catches. Mack Hollins played 92% of snaps and is on Sebas350.
- **Woody Marks** (HOU, Game of Throws): he left early in the third quarter with a concussion and did not return. The report says his chances for Thursday's game against the Colts look very slim. Emari Demercado is next up and played 33% of snaps.
- **Drake London** (ATL, Justiniscleann): he was evaluated for a concussion in the closing minutes and stayed out. He had 12 targets, six catches and **109 yards** first. Jahan Dotson (72% of snaps) is next up.
- **Travis Kelce** (KC, Moore Than A Bite): he left with an ankle injury after one 23-yard catch, then returned. He played 31% of snaps and scored 5.0. Noah Gray played 85%.
- **Geno Smith** (NYJ): he exited twice with head and ankle injuries, and rookie Cade Klubnik attempted 20 passes. Garrett Wilson, who is returning from a concussion, still had **14 targets** and 106 yards.
- **Chig Okonkwo** (WAS, I Love it Ra): he left Thursday with a back injury but returned. He finished with four catches for 24 yards.

**Backfield situations**
- **Kaleb Johnson** (GB, Lover Boys): Josh Jacobs was out with a finger injury and Johnson was a popular pickup. He played only **25%** of snaps and scored 4.2. Chris Brooks played 47%.
- **Ollie Gordon II** (MIA, Moore Than A Bite): he played 71% of snaps and scored 15.5. The news says he has had 16+ carries in each of the last four games since De'Von Achane's season-ending knee injury.

sections.title: Around the league
sections.md:
- **The Dakstreet Boys** had the high score at **179.42**, beating Lover Boys. They are 2-7.
- **Lover Boys** lost despite Pickens (43.5) and Chase (34.1). They benched Mahomes (35.42) and left **42.42** on the bench, but even the best lineup wouldn't have won.
- **Just Win Baby**, the 8-1 leader, lost 168.56 to 149.30 against Moore Than A Bite, who are now 6-3.
- **Chentudo El Venudo** beat Game of Throws 121.46 to 118.76 and are 7-2.
  - Game of Throws would have won with its best lineup. Alvin Kamara scored 16.4 on the bench while Braelon Allen had 5.6.
- **SMA** beat Sebas350 111.54 to 110.58, a margin of **0.96**.
  - Sebas350 would have won with its best lineup. Jalen Coker's 0.3 was started over Jadarian Price's 11.4.
- **Justiniscleann** (5-4) beat Bucky Charms 158.82 to 98.88.
- **I Love it Ra** (5-4) beat us despite leaving **31.1** on the bench, the second-most in the league.

sections.title: Grading last week's preview
sections.md:
Last week's preview suggested a lineup that would have scored **89.32**. Your lineup scored **100.22**, so you did better than the suggestion by about 10.9 points. The best possible was 113.92.

- **Brenton Strange over Tank Dell:** right. Strange scored 8.9 and Dell scored 5.1, a gain of 3.8 points. It was a close call before kickoff, though.
- **Audric Estime over Aaron Jones:** can't grade. The facts have no score for Estime, so only Jones's **12.5** is known. This call would have been hard to justify with those numbers, but without Estime's score I can't say for sure.
